summary: Copies a mesh header plus its bounding/geometry data from a source mesh structure (a1) into a caller-supplied destination char buffer (a2). First strcpy's the "cube.mts" filename string into the buffer, then copies two header dwords (source this+0x14 and this+0x18) to destination +0x14/+0x18, bulk-copies 96 bytes (24 dwords) from source dwords 7..30 to destination bytes 28..123, copies the bounding-volume/geometry block from source this+0x7C..this+0x84 to destination +0xDC..+0xE4, and copies the OBB/plane-data block from source this+0x94..this+0xD4 to destination +0xF4..+0x134. Returns 0. Invoked during mesh serialization from sub_54AC70.

operations.description: strcpy(a2, aCubeMts410) copies the "cube.mts" filename string into the destination buffer; the returned pointer v2 (end of the string) is used as the write base for the numeric fields.
*((_DWORD*)v2 + 5) = a1[5]; copy the first mesh header dword from source this+0x14 to destination +0x14.
*((_DWORD*)v2 + 6) = a1[6]; copy the second mesh header dword from source this+0x18 to destination +0x18.
qmemcpy(v2 + 28, a1 + 7, 0x60) bulk-copies 96 bytes (24 dwords) from source dwords 7..30 to destination bytes 28..123; the covered source range is not decomposed into named fields.
Copy the bounding-volume/geometry dwords from source this+0x7C, this+0x80, this+0x84 (a1[31..33]) to destination +0xDC, +0xE0, +0xE4.
Copy the OBB/plane-data block from source this+0x94 .. this+0xD4 (a1[37..53]) to destination dwords 61..77 (bytes +0xF4 .. +0x134).

unresolved: The source dwords 7..30 covered by the qmemcpy are not named fields in the packet, so their per-dword meaning is unknown.
Destination dwords 58..60 are never written from the source, leaving a gap in the copied header between the dword-57 and dword-61 writes.
